limitations: Avoidance definition uses the base field — Counterevidence: The abstract,p2,p10,p14 and proof already require C(K)=empty.

Computable axiomatization needs an effective base — Counterevidence: Companion existence does not require effective language. Section2 proof locally specializes toQ; numberfield/Q applications are effective.
Chow bound does not control nonpure components — Counterevidence: Downstream Gamma and Va under irreducibility condition are integral; needed Chow fact holds for them.

Weil restriction product repeats factors — Counterevidence: Correct product over3 embeddings still has transitive Gaction and no fixedfactor. Nonconstant product-to-C map depends on unique factor by4.3.
Proper elementary extensions retain curve avoidance — Counterevidence: Theorem4.14 has proper algebraic extensionPAC, gives intendedCpoint and axiomIC.
Rational function field satisfies only avoidance theory — Counterevidence: K(t)modelsCXFforall is enough to invoke4.16 and get regularK'/K(t)modelsCXF, K elementaryK'.
Recalled TP2 condition is exactly IP without row inconsistency — Counterevidence: Cor4.29 relies instead on actual externalPAC unbounded=>TP2 theorem, notmerelyprintedpattern.

repair.content:
Replace C(K0) by C(K); main construction remains for intended C-avoiding fields.

Require computable presentation/effectively available base diagram, or explicitly say relative scheme.

Restrict to pure-dimensional/irreducible varieties or bound sum of all component degrees.

Index by Hom_K(L,F) orG/Gal(F/L), not fullG.

Replace elementary with algebraic; derive using4.14.

Write CXFforall at this step and retainregular-extensionconstruction.

Require fixedfinitek>=2 rowk-inconsistency and everypath consistency.
